annotations.title: Read a group chat: its members and messages

description: Read a group chat: its members and messages. Use it for context before you write to a group, or to see who is in it. A group you are in, with its members and pending proposals, and its messages in `group_seq` order after `after`: those sent while you were a member. Unknown groups and groups you are not in both return 404. Needs the personal token.

after.description: Return only messages after this sequence number. 0 (the default) starts at the beginning.
